skins.name: Retro Carpet

Balanced repeat of chunky motifs at readable scale with generous dark gaps, not tiny confetti noise. All motifs are printed FLAT, none are floating or raised. Matte smooth toy body with no actual fuzzy fibers. Solid muted purple snout, cyan inner ears and feet, black bead eyes. Full coat around sides and rear, face readable. No emission, no aura, no added geometry. Title RETRO CARPET; subtitle RARE / ARCADE.

skins.name: Respawn
skins.design: Midnight purple pig with a bold cyan and violet pixel-dissolve coat, large blocky stepped patterns growing from lower legs across flanks toward rump, magenta accent squares. Dark purple snout, two cyan glowing bead eyes. A SMALL amount of geometry: 6 to 9 little emissive cyan/violet cubes lifting close to the rear back in a gentle ascending stream, a few pixel spark particles. Most of the body remains solid and whole; no missing body chunks. One discreet printed pixel upward arrow on each flank. Narrow luminous seams in the stepped coat communicate a slow respawn pulse. Clearly an authored coat plus restrained glow and aura, less geometry than a legendary; no armor, giant halo or apparatus. Title RESPAWN; subtitle EPIC / ARCADE.

skins.name: Jackpot
skins.design: A deep burgundy pig with warm ivory snout, gold/brass feet and inner ears, readable black bead eyes. Its upper REAR back supports one substantial compact arcade prize-reel housing, firmly seated on a fitted saddle base behind the ears, visibly attached. Housing is polished brass with burgundy side panels, three actual cylindrical mechanical reels side by side under a low curved frame; reel faces carry simple star, cherry and diamond emblems (no numbers, no brand). Framed amber light bulbs provide glow. No sign towers, no giant machine swallowing the pig. Rear view explains saddle mounting and rounded back of housing, same geometry in both views. Small gold arcade tokens orbit CLOSE around rear flanks with sparse amber sparkle aura, no tokens in front of eyes or feet. Clearly substantial added 3D geometry, moving reels and token effects, warm controlled glow. Show reels with crisp symbols plus subtle motion ticks to indicate spin, keep actual buildable geometry readable. Title JACKPOT; subtitle LEGENDARY / ARCADE.
